_comment: Publish this file to the ROOT of the wubrg-tracker-pc repo's main branch. The app fetches it from raw.githubusercontent.com — see src/lib/storeVersion.js. Editing it takes effect within 6 hours on every device; no OTA or store release needed.

_fields.minSupportedVersion: Native versions BELOW this show the non-dismissible 'no longer supported' banner. Set it to the new native version ONLY once that version is live on Google Play — before then you would be telling users to install something that isn't there yet.
_fields.latestVersion: Newest native version on the store. Shows a dismissible 'version X is available' nudge to anyone below it but at or above minSupportedVersion.
_fields.message: Optional. Overrides the default banner copy for both states. Omit to use the built-in wording.
_fields.playStoreUrl: Informational only — the app builds its own URL from the package name.
